messages.subject: Problems in follow: 6.10 SPDE book example using my data
parts:
Dear all,

I'm trying to follow the book example: 6.10 SPDE for Gaussian response: Swiss rainfall data, using my data. I'm having problems with something in data preparation section.

Many thanks in advance.

Greetings 

Miguel

dem <- readGDAL("dem.asc")  # Here importing dem
dem <- as(dem, 'RasterLayer') # to transform SpatialGridDataFrame to RasterLayer
e <- raster::extent(590274.7, 599512.2, 2168683, 2179551) #extend for crop
Zen_dem <- crop(dem, extent(e), snap="out")

In Data preparation section everything goes right, but when I try to create the regular grid of points where rainfall prediction will be computed I got this Errors:

 seq.x.grid <- seq(from=Zen_dem@coords[1,1],to=Zen_dem1@coords[2,1],length=x.res)/1000
Error in seq(from = Zen_dem@coords[1, 1], to = Zen_dem1@coords[2, 1],  : 
  no slot of name "coords" for this object of class "SpatialGridDataFrame"
